categories.summary: The streamer is a pure, heavily audit-hardened reducer: char-counted (120-byte CNCjs-margin) plus ping-pong modes, oversized-line preflight that refuses a >RX-buffer line loudly, terminal-absorbing statuses (trailing oks after error:N can't fake a clean finish), paused-drain semantics, alarm wipes in-flight accounting, and a lone-M0 tool-change hold (CNC multi-bit resume, closing critical S8-F1). An untracked-ack ledger, stall watchdog, and fingerprint checkpoint back it. Real long-job hardware stability stays CLAIMED.
